m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, the handoff, and ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format); if incomplete, block and return. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete
postconditions.satisfied_by: Read CREW_CONTEXT.md, GLOSSARY.md, ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, HANDOFF.md. Handoff complete: task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions/return-format all present.

m1-step1-evidence-model.title: STEP 1 (BLOCKING): Determine evidence model with file:line proof
m1-step1-evidence-model.imperative: Read sampled_backtest.py (oracle modes at ~638-643), sample_state_adapter.py (source='quali_order' vs sampled-start logic), and how race_start evidence is built. Definitively answer: does --mode sampled_state feed ACTUAL qualifying results, or predict quali/start from PRACTICE only (pre-quali)? Conclude (a) sampled_state IS pre-quali -> use directly, or (b) it uses observed quali -> use a practice-only restriction. Cite file:line. This gates all numbers.

preconditions.satisfied_by: m0-context complete; context loaded and handoff verified complete

postconditions.statement: evidence-model verdict reached with file:line proof; pre-quali vs observed-quali determined; durable note recorded
postconditions.satisfied_by: VERDICT: sampled_state is PRE-QUALI. Proof in STEP1_EVIDENCE_MODEL.md (6 file:line citations). Oracle injection only in oracle_grid/oracle_all_states; sampled_state seeds stages from model's own sampled orders.

constraints: Read the code; cite file:line. Do not assume. Leakage-critical.

m2-step2-2025-anchor.title: STEP 2: Clean 2025 pre-quali fantasy from Jun-8 gold (anchor)
m2-step2-2025-anchor.imperative: Using the clean Jun-8 gold bundles (params/gold/runtime_bundles/gold_cycle_260608_043414_2018thru2024 + fusion params/gold/fusion/fusion_260608_084626_2018thru2024.json, or committed manifest reports/evo/fusion_260608_084626_2018thru2024.sampled_runtime_manifest.json), compute the pre-quali (per Step 1 verdict) fantasy season score for 2025 via src/fantasy_scoring. Sanity: ~849 if sampled_state is pre-quali. Compare to human 711. NO retraining; DB-only; reuse fantasy_scoring.

preconditions.satisfied_by: Step 1 verdict reached: sampled_state is pre-quali

postconditions.statement: 2025 pre-quali model fantasy season score computed via fantasy_scoring with command evidence pasted; provenance: gold train_years exclude 2025 confirmed
postconditions.satisfied_by: 2025 pre-quali sampled_state season_total=849.0 (matches ~849 sanity). Gold excludes 2025 (train_years=[2018..2024]). Reused fantasy_scoring; trained JSON mode=sampled_state, oracle_*_used=False.

constraints: INFERENCE only - no retraining/gold cycle. DB-only. NEVER touch params/gold/per_race_predictions/ (LEAKED). Reuse src/fantasy_scoring.

m3-step3-loso-2022-2024.title: STEP 3: 2022/2023/2024 via LOSO folds (leakage-free by construction)
m3-step3-loso-2022-2024.imperative: For each Y in {2022,2023,2024}: (1) VERIFY leakage-free - read a heldout_<Y> module manifest, confirm training years EXCLUDE Y; if any include Y, STOP and report. (2) Assemble a v4 sampled-runtime manifest from outputs/evo_runs/gold_module_training_cycle/loso_folds/heldout_<Y>/modules/ fused with gold fusion config. (3) Run the pre-quali backtest (per Step 1) for season Y, extract per-race top-10 (position_distribution ascending mean), fantasy-score vs DB actuals (data/f1_data_<Y>.db session_classifications R) via src/fantasy_scoring. NOTE caveat: gold fusion saw Y OOF metrics (structural) - flag as follow-up.

preconditions.statement: Step 1 verdict + Step 2 anchor pipeline established
preconditions.satisfied_by: Step 1 verdict + Step 2 anchor pipeline established (849.0)

postconditions.statement: per-Y leakage-free verification (manifest excludes Y) for 2022/2023/2024; per-Y pre-quali fantasy season score computed via fantasy_scoring with command evidence; gold-fusion-saw-OOF caveat recorded

constraints: INFERENCE only - no retraining. STOP if any heldout_<Y> module includes Y in training. DB-only. NEVER touch leaked per_race_predictions. Reuse fantasy_scoring.

m4-step4-report.title: STEP 4: Write report (json + md) and table
m4-step4-report.imperative: Write reports/walkforward/multiseason_fantasy.{json,md}: the model-vs-human table for 2022-2025 (model pre-quali leakage-free, human 739/632/615/711, delta), Step-1 evidence-model verdict with file:line proof, per-season provenance block (each model excludes its eval season; no leaked March artifact touched), and the gold-fusion-saw-OOF caveat. Write the files but do NOT git-commit (Commander handles git).

postconditions.statement: reports/walkforward/multiseason_fantasy.json and .md exist with table, Step-1 verdict, per-season provenance, caveat; files written not committed

check.command: py -c "import json,os; p='reports/walkforward/multiseason_fantasy.json'; assert os.path.exists(p); d=json.load(open(p)); assert os.path.exists('reports/walkforward/multiseason_fantasy.md'); print('OK', sorted(d.keys()))"
